arxiv-2212-03198.title: A new method to invert InSAR data to resolve stress changes on a fracture embedded in a 3D heterogeneous crust
arxiv-2212-03198.creator: Oliver Bodart, Valérie Cayol, Farshid Dabaghi
arxiv-2212-03198.description: Abstract We present a new method to invert variable stress changes of fractures from InSAR ground displacements. Fractures can be either faults or magma intrusions, embeded in a 3D heterogeneous crust with prominent topographies. The method is based on a fictituous domain approach using a finite element discretization of XFEM type.

arxiv-2302-13984.title: Probing the Stellar Wind of the Wolf-Rayet Star in IC 10 X-1
arxiv-2302-13984.creator: Sayantan Bhattacharya, Silas G. T. Laycock, André-Nicolas Chené, Breanna A. Binder, Dimitris M. Christodoulou, Ankur Roy, Nicholas M. Sorabella, Rigel C. Cappallo
arxiv-2302-13984.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sayantan Bhattacharya, Silas G. T. Laycock, André-Nicolas Chené, Breanna A. Binder, Dimitris M. Christodoulou, Ankur Roy, Nicholas M. Sorabella, Rigel C. Cappallo. IC 10 X-1 is an eclipsing high mass X-ray binary (HMXB) containing a stellar-mass black hole (BH) and a Wolf-Rayet (WR) donor star with an orbital period of P = 34.9 P=34.9 hr.

arxiv-2305-03313.title: Cosmic rays from heavy particle decays
arxiv-2305-03313.creator: E.V. Arbuzova, A.D. Dolgov, A.A. Nikitenko
arxiv-2305-03313.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by E.V. Arbuzova, A.D. Dolgov, A.A. Nikitenko. Multidimensional modification of gravity with a smaller mass scale of the gravitational interaction is considered. Stable by assumption dark matter particles could decay via interactions with virtual black holes. The decay rates of such processes are estimated. It is shown that with the proper fixation of the parameters the decays of these ultra-massive particles can give noticeable contribution to the flux of high energy cosmic rays in particular, near the Greisen-Zatsepin-Kuzmin limit.

arxiv-2502-03244.title: Analysis of Value Iteration Through Absolute Probability Sequences
arxiv-2502-03244.creator: Arsenii Mustafin *, Sebastien Colla *, Alex Olshevsky, Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis
arxiv-2502-03244.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arsenii Mustafin *, Sebastien Colla *, Alex Olshevsky, Ioannis Ch. Paschalidis. Value Iteration is a widely used algorithm for solving Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). While previous studies have extensively analyzed its convergence properties, they primarily focus on convergence with respect to the infinity norm. In this work, we use absolute probability sequences to develop a new line of analysis and examine the algorithm’s convergence in terms of the L 2 L^{2} norm, offering a new perspective on its behavior and performance.

pmc-11623893.description: Background:Arm morbidity and postoperative complications following sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) or axillary lymph node dissection (ALND) are common problems in patients with breast cancer. pmc-13107849.title: Clinical impact of a multidisciplinary remote-based hybrid antibiotic stewardship program in critically ill patients during COVID-19 pandemic in Korea: a prospective pilot implementation study
pmc-13107849.creator: Suhyun Lee, Soyun Park, Min Gu Shin, Hyeong Geun Jo, Kyeoul Jeong, Ji-Eun Yoon, Kyong Nam Ye, Yeo Jin Choi, Minseo Choe, Seungwon Yang, Pureunnarae Kang, Jung-Tae Kim, Sung Wook Kang, Eun Kyoung Chung
pmc-13107849.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial stewardship programs (ASPs) are recommended to optimize antibiotic use in intensive care units (ICUs); however, many institutions lack infectious disease specialists and pharmacy expertise for full implementation. The COVID-19 pandemic further disrupted conventional stewardship. While tele-stewardship models have shown promise, evidence for hybrid programs operating without infectious disease specialist leadership remains limited, particularly outside high-income countries.

pmc-13654804.title: Transdiagnostic behavioral and sociodemographic influences on the cognitive-adaptive functioning gap in neurodivergent children
pmc-13654804.creator: Eric Wan, Melanie Penner, Jennifer Crosbie, Jessica Brian, Elizabeth Kelley, Russell Schachar, Marc Woodbury-Smith, Jessica Jones, Robert Nicolson, Ryan A. Stevenson, Julia Frei, Elisabetta Trinari, Paul D. Arnold, Mohammad Ayub, Jason P. Lerch, Evdokia Anagnostou, Azadeh Kushki
pmc-13654804.description: Adaptive functioning typically aligns with cognitive ability in the general population, but this relationship appears more complex in neurodivergent populations. Individuals with autism, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) frequently show a discrepancy between cognitive ability and adaptive functioning. However, the behavioral and sociodemographic factors associated with this cognitive-adaptive functioning gap remain unclear.

uslaw-usc-t46-s30525.title: 46 U.S.C. § 30525 — Apportionment of losses
uslaw-usc-t46-s30525.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s30525.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Chapter 305 (Exoneration And Limitation Of Liability); Subchapter II (Exoneration And Limitation Of Liability). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If the amounts determined under sections 30523 and 30524 of this title are insufficient to pay all claims— (1) all claimants shall be paid in proportion to their respective losses out of the amount determined under section.
